newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to stall at 102.50 resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to stall at 102.50 resistance.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE will continue to grind higher on Monday, but will run out of steam around 102.50, technical analysts said.
That level was the 50 percent retracement of the fall from 103.51 on July 31 to 101.50 on August 6.

"The gradual drift higher is still in place for the short term," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London. "But I'm looking for it to top out around the 102.50/63 resistance zone. The whole move is a corrective one."
September Bund futures were up 0.11 at 102.25 by 0700 GMT.
Above 102.50, the next resistance was 102.63, the low on July 25.

Analysts at Chase in London said in a research note intraday support comes in at 102.00, and a decline below that level would target 101.59/44. The 101.44 level was the lower boundary of an ascending trend channel on weekly charts.
"A weekly closing price below 101.44 calls for an initial test of 100.94, and if below here it will move to 100.00," the note said.
Wilkin identified support from a bulltrend at 101.75, the channel bottom. It was backed up by the Aug 14 low at 101.72.
Below there, 101.50 was the key level of support. It was the August 6 low and a break through there would be a bear signal, analysts said.
"If it breaks then we'll see a quick move to 100.93," said Wilkin. "That's just under 100.94, the low on June 20 and a 62 percent retracement of the 99.32 to 103.52 move."
He said he was looking for a full retracement further out, back to the 99.00 area.
At the short end, December Euromarks were up 0.03 at 96.45.
